::: {#def-preorder}
#### Preorder

The **preorder** $\operatorname{preorder}(T)$ of a binary tree $T$ (@def-binary-tree) [@wikipedia_tree_traversal]
is the list (@def-list) of the labels of its vertices defined recursively,
following the recursive definition of binary trees:

$$
\ba
\operatorname{preorder}(\mathtt{nil}) &= \mathtt{empty},
\\ \operatorname{preorder}\paren{\operatorname{node}(x, L, R)} &= \operatorname{cons}\paren{x, \operatorname{app}\paren{\operatorname{preorder}(L), \operatorname{preorder}(R)}},
\ea
$$

where $\operatorname{app}$ is the append (@def-append).
The root comes before its subtrees.

:::
